method: Fresh Node per sample; warm up twice with one quarter of the iterations. Time one Forge callback with hrtime.bigint, including builder finish and reset. Hash full string outputs after timing. Python checks each result independently. Alternate AB/BA by pair, stagger first order by case. Samples are chronological.
